title: senna ligustrina
intro: Senna ligustrina, commonly known as Tinnevelly senna, is a plant species native to India and parts of Africa, belonging to the legume family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural laxative and help with digestion, due to its therapeutic actions of stimulating the bowels and relieving constipation. The bioactive constituents of Senna ligustrina include anthraquinone glycosides, such as sennosides, which are responsible for its purgative effects. The plant's medicinal properties are attributed to its ability to induce bowel movements and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome.
